s1.text: S1: no 'unclear' outcome at title/abstract. The checklist rule includes only when every inclusion box is true (calibration.py:79); a missing box counts as false (calibration.py:97); MAYBE is refused at finalize (collector.py:857). A title-only record ('No abstract available.', batcher.py:359) therefore tends to EXCLUDE, the opposite of 'when in doubt, include'. Boards 2 and 5.

s2.text: S2 (bug): on the checklist path the screener's written reasoning is not passed on (collector.py:842), so every decision is recorded with the reason 'Agent screened.' (collector.py:928). Small harness fix.

s3.text: S3: legacy decision files get invented defaults: a missing decision becomes INCLUDE (collector.py:851) and a missing confidence becomes 0.80 (collector.py:871). UAV lesson 31: absent fields are debt, never fabricated. Board 7.

s4.text: S4: 'confidence' is a constant set by the rule (0.90 include, 0.55 exclusion hit, 0.75 inclusion miss; calibration.py:109), not a measured confidence. Board 5 shows the criterion pattern instead.

s5.text: S5: dual screening exists only through file names (batch_*_decisions_screener2.json plus _adjudication_resolved_group_*.json, collector.py:335). No command prepares or tracks screener 2, and the harness reports no agreement. Boards 2, 4 and 6.

s6.text: S6: calibration falls back to a heuristic when no gold file is given (agent_screen.py:79). Calibrating an agent against a heuristic is not calibration. Board 3 asks for your own labels.

s7.text: S7: prepare needs an accepted corpus snapshot in the artifact registry (batcher.py:198); the Phase-1 hand-off does not say how to get one. Board 2 shows the binding and the missing step.

s8.text: S8: batches follow corpus order (batcher.py:266), so provider blocks land together (lesson 48). Board 2 offers a seeded shuffle.

s9.text: S9: review and approve work one batch at a time (--batch N). At 20 per batch, 3,241 works is ~160 batches. Board 5 replaces this with one risk-ranked queue; board 8 approves the generation once.

s10.text: S10 (strengths): batches bind protocol and corpus fingerprints; exact coverage and stale-binding checks; the worker never invents reasons; a publication approval gates collect; refused files are renamed .rejected, not deleted.

s11.text: S11: status shows done or pending per batch only; file validity and exclusion reasons appear only at collect (collector.py:59). Board 4 validates each file as it lands.
